description:
R&T Software Engineer – GNSS Simulation 

 Granada, Spain

  

 We're looking for a R&T Software Engineer– GNSS Simulation  to join our R&T team in Granada, Spain and provide direct technical support in the development, validation, and evolution of our GNSS simulation and interference detection capabilities.

 


 Our Technology: 

 Safran Electronics and Defense is a world leader in Resilient Positioning, Navigation and Timing (R-PNT) solutions that improve the reliability, performance and safety of critical applications, and high-risk operations, even in GPS/GNSS denied environments. We provide virtually fail-safe GNSS and PNT solutions for military and commercial applications worldwide.

 Our team contributes to national/international innovation projects and business opportunities focused on resilient positioning, navigation and timing, GNSS simulation, timing distribution, synchronization technologies and interference detection and mitigation. The team develops and validates advanced simulation capabilities, including GNSS scenarios involving jamming, spoofing, signal degradation, and resilient PNT use cases. These activities support both research demonstrators and future product capabilities.

 To this end, we work with technologies related to ultra-accurate synchronization (sub-ns) and frequency distribution. This allows to deliver a broad set of products and technical solutions based on the enhanced White Rabbit PTP synchronization technology for a variety of applications, ranging from timing distribution in financial networks to robust and reliable positioning.  

  

 The Position: 

 


 As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will start working on a highly motivating engagement with the R&T Engineering Team in Granada, Spain, where you will be expected to develop the elements and tools of the GNSS simulation platform.

 As an R&T Software Engineer, you will work closely with the GNSS Simulation team to extend the capabilities of our simulation platform, develop embedded software components and C-based functionalities, and support the improvement of interference detection and signal processing algorithms.

 Thus, you will assist in the development, integration, and validation of the main critical scenarios under study. This could include custom simulation modules, user-level applications, software libraries, or even develop/test automation procedures. Moreover, you will implement the necessary extensions to our simulation scenarios, and debug and diagnose any issues arising during the design of these extensions. 

 You will be involved in national/international collaborative R&T projects, where technical rigor, clear communication, structured documentation is key, and the ability to contribute to demonstrators and technical deliverables is essential. Capability to elaborate showcase proof of concepts and traveling to technical meetings is expected.

  

 What you’ll be doing: 

 


 
  You will have the responsibility for understanding the requirements and assisting in the development of a project that includes highly innovative elements.

 You will use your critical thinking and problem-solving skills to ensure highest quality results in accordance with the schedule, effort, and budget.

 You will have effective communication with other project partners, project managers, and will be constantly communicating with them from project kick-offs to stakeholder meetings.

 

 
 More specifically on the technical side:

 


 
 Develop and maintain software components and C-based plugins for GNSS simulation platforms.

 Extend simulator capabilities to support new GNSS scenarios, including interference, jamming, spoofing, signal degradation, and resilient PNT use cases.

 Support the design, implementation, and evaluation of signal processing algorithms for interference detection and mitigation.

 Work with embedded Linux environments and contribute to low-level or system-level software development.

 Apply real-time programming concepts and support multithreaded or parallel software implementations when required.

 Prototype, test, and compare technical approaches using C, C++, Python, and scripting tools.

 Validate software components through unit tests, integration tests, test campaigns, and reproducible validation procedures.

 Analyze test results, debug technical issues, and document findings clearly.

 Use Git-based version control workflows and contribute to maintaining software configuration discipline.

 Prepare technical documentation, validation reports, design notes, and project deliverables.

 Support technical planning, task definition, research analysis, and project follow-up activities.

 Contribute to demonstrations, proofs of concept, and technical reviews with internal and external partners.

 
  

 Main responsabilities:

 


 
 Contribute to the definition of technical specifications, software requirements, and validation criteria

 Develop, test, and document software components according to the project plan

 Support the implementation of new GNSS simulation capabilities and interference detection functions.

 Estimate workload for assigned tasks and report progress, risks, and technical issues

 Maintain software configuration using version control tools and agreed development workflows.

 Define and execute module, integration, and validation tests.

 Produce technical deliverables, including design notes, validation reports, test procedures, and user documentation.

 Support task definition and technical inputs for new proposals aligned with the R&T roadmap.

 Participate in the final qualification of deliverables, including software and documentation validation.

 
  

 What you Bring to our Team :

 


 
  Master’s Degree in Informatics, Telecommunications, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

 Good written and communication skills in English.

 Ambition to grow and develop personally and professionally. Passion for challenges and technology. Ability to participate in ambitious projects with major international technology leaders.

 
 


 More on the technical side:

 


 
 Solid programming skills in C, with knowledge of C++ and Python.

 Basic knowledge of digital signal processing.

 Familiarity with Linux-based development environments.

 Understanding of software validation, debugging, testing, and version control.

 Structured mindset, autonomy, and ability to learn complex technical topics.

 Interest in GNSS, resilient PNT, signal processing, simulation, and applied research.

 
  

 More specific desirable experience in: 

 


 
 Embedded software development, testing, and debugging.

 Real-time programming and multithreaded or parallel programming.

 Development of C-based plugins, simulation modules, software interfaces, or low-level software components.

 Digital signal processing applied to GNSS, RF signals, interference detection, or signal quality monitoring.

 RF systems, including basic understanding of RF front-ends, spectrum analysis, signal propagation, and interference effects.

 GNSS, SDR, spoofing, jamming, or interference detection techniques.

 Automation and scripting skills, for example Bash, TCL, or Python.

 Version control systems and collaborative development workflows, especially Git.

 Software validation, unit testing, integration testing, CI/CD, or automated validation environment.

 Timing, synchronization, and frequency dissemination protocols such as PTP, NTP, SyncE, White Rabbit, or similar technologies.

 Technical documentation, validation reports, test procedures, and project deliverables.

 Proficiency in written and spoken English.

 Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

 Teamwork and collaboration skills.

 
 


 You do not have to bring everything listed here, but any of this would be a plus!

  

 The keys of our offer: 

 


 
 Be part of a leading and expanding company.

 Health insurance.

 Flexible work schedule.

 International and dynamic environment in Granada, Spain with some travels and collaborations with other teams in the company in EU and United States.

 High possibilities to grow inside the company.

 Professional Career Plan.

 
 


 Safran is an equal opportunity employer who does not discriminate based on race, color, citizenship, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran’s status or any protected category. We encourage veterans and people with disabilities to apply.
